Participants start in white clothing and are colored with colored powder every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the end. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, on the route along Unirii Boulevard and surrounding areas, offering a festive experience accessible to all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, with special moments such as the cloud of colored powder and live music.

Coloring points with powder every kilometer traveled

name: Wings for Life World App Run : Oradea
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair users, where there is no fixed finish line. Participants run to stay ahead of the Virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the start and gradually increases its speed until everyone is caught. The event in Oradea, Romania, on May 10, 2026, takes place on a 1.7 km paved circuit inside the Nokian Tyres factory. All registration fees and donations go entirely to spinal cord injury research.
course_highlights: 1.7 km paved circuit inside the Nokian Tyres factory
Open participation for runners and wheelchair users
Virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the start and increases speed gradually
additional: The event is accessible for wheelchair participants. The start is simultaneous worldwide, and the Virtual Catcher Car begins chasing 30 minutes after the start with an initial speed of 14 km/h, increasing progressively. 100% of registration fees and donations are directed towards spinal cord injury research projects. The event supports participation at any distance, with no fixed finish line, and includes registration via an app. Participants can run individually or in groups, and all funds raised are allocated to spinal cord injury research.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 invites you to run in the heart of Transylvania, through the city center of Târgu Mureș, on May 10, 2026. The event offers various routes of 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 4x5 km relay, and a children's race, all starting and finishing in the central area, ideal for support from family and friends. Participants will discover the city's representative tourist spots in a vibrant spring atmosphere, enjoying prizes, medals, and good energy with every step. The organizer is the Mureș Runners Association, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and community through sport.
course_highlights: Routes through the center of Târgu Mureș, with representative tourist points
Start and finish in the Theater Square, the central area of the city
Variety of events: half marathon 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4x5 km relay, and children's race
additional: The registration package includes an official T-shirt, race number, timing chip, finisher medal, sponsor brochures, online diplomas, official photos, and access to hydration and refreshment points. The mandatory equipment at the start includes running shoes, sportswear, and a visible race number. The event promotes environmental protection, with a ban on littering outside designated areas. Participants can choose from multiple distances, including half marathon, relay, and children's race; the event encourages physical activity and local tourism in Târgu Mureș.

name: Budureasa Mountain Running
description: Budureasa Mountain Running is a mountain running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with the Budureasa Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes two main categories: Eco Cross 8 km and Cross 16 km, dedicated to endurance runners aged at least 14 years. The routes start and end in front of the Budureasa Cultural Center, offering a mountain experience with ascents and descents on stone roads, trail, and asphalt. Along the course, there are revitalization points with water, isotonic drinks, and fruits. Participation is open to all capable runners, with special conditions for minors under 18.
course_highlights: Shared route for Eco Cross 8 km and Cross 16 km up to km 4.5 with a revitalization point
Steep ascents and significant elevation changes, including a 450 m climb with a 170 m positive difference
Last kilometers on asphalt, with hydration points and gentle descents
additional: Participation confirmation is done on Saturday between 16:00 - 20:00 or on race day between 8:00 - 10:30 at the Budureasa Cultural Center. Technical meeting on Saturday 09.05.2026 between 19:00 - 19:30 and on race day at 10:00. There are 3 revitalization points along the route for the 16 km Cross and 1 point for the 8 km Eco Cross with water, isotonic drinks, and fruits. Registrations are only valid after payment of the fee, and changes or cancellations can only be made in writing until 26.04.2026. Athletes suspended for doping are not allowed to participate. The route may be modified due to weather conditions; online registration is open until May 3, 2026, with on-site registration also possible; restrictions apply for minors; anti-doping rules are enforced.

name: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026

description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 is a 5-kilometer race full of positive energy, color, and fun, perfect for all ages and fitness levels. The event is not timed, with an emphasis on the joy of running and the vibrant experience of colors applied every kilometer. The urban course starts and ends in Unirii Square, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple successive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the end. Participants receive a kit with a t-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.
course_highlights: Urban 5 km course in the center of Cluj, starting and finishing in Unirii Square
Application of colored powder every kilometer
Explosion of colored powder at the finish, accompanied by live music
additional: The event has multiple successive starts at 5-minute intervals, and participants must wear their race number visibly on their t-shirt. There is no baggage storage area. Participation with bicycles, roller skates, scooters, or pets is prohibited. The access bracelet is received at the entrance to the event area based on the participation number and t-shirt. The medal and colored powder are given at the finish. Participants receive a participation kit with a t-shirt, race number, bandana, tattoo, medal, and colored powder; the event promotes a healthy and active lifestyle; pets and vehicles are not allowed on the course.

description: The T.E.A.M. Run is a charitable sporting event organized in Timisoara that combines movement with solidarity to support children from the "Inima Îți Vorbește" Association. The event is participatory, without timing or rankings, and offers a pleasant experience for all ages, with races dedicated to babies, children, and adults. The routes include central areas of the city, and the funds collected support the project "Casa InimiiLor", a therapeutic refuge for children. Participation is a demonstration of solidarity and hope for those in need.
course_highlights: Routes include Piata Libertatii and Piata Victoriei, with distances adapted for different age categories
Participatory event without timing, all participants receive participation medals
Charitable support for the children of the "Inima Îți Vorbește" Association through the Casa InimiiLor project
additional: Distribution of participation kits is done in the days prior to the event at the Wendhill Academy headquarters in Iulius Mall (second floor). The start and finish are in Piata Libertatii. Participants in baby races are carried in a pouch or in arms, and children's races have special rules regarding accompaniment by parents or legal guardians. The event has an official opening and a technical meeting before the start. The event promotes solidarity and community involvement, providing an opportunity to support the children of the "Inima Îți Vorbește" Association through participation and donations.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu is a top mountain running event in Romania, held in Moieciu de Sus. The race includes Marathon, Semi, and Cross categories, as well as a race for children, EcoKids. The routes are composed of approximately 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic outdoor running experience with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. The event promotes sustainable practices and takes place annually in May, bringing together runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Marathon route of approximately 42 km with 2400 m positive elevation gain
Semi route of approximately 28 km with 1350 m positive elevation gain
Cross route of approximately 14 km with 750 m positive elevation gain, mostly on forest roads and mountain trails
additional: The start for the Cross and Marathon will be given in two waves, at 9:00 and 9:15, depending on the estimated time at registration. Marathon participants will start at 9:00, with the time displayed on their bib. There is a relaxation area and Pasta Party after the race at Vlahia Inn. EcoKids races have separate starts by age categories starting at 15:00. Registrations for the main races open on March 8, 2026, and close on May 1, 2026, subject to availability. Mountain routes, activities such as pasta party and floral ceremonies, with an emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly practices.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge is a mountain running competition held on marked trails in Turnu Roșu and on the hills at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a spectacular natural setting and a challenge for all levels of fitness. The event includes three races: a half marathon of 21 km, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each adapted for different types of participants, from experienced to those seeking a relaxing experience. Organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socialization, providing facilities such as stretching sessions, post-run massages, camping, and activities for children. It is an excellent opportunity to enjoy nature, sport, and community in Sibiu County.
course_highlights: Trails on natural paths, forest roads, and meadows
Spectacular landscapes at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains
Three races adapted for all levels of fitness
additional: Participants receive a medal, race number, optional T-shirt for an additional cost, meal voucher, and carbohydrate gel. After the race, regenerative massage and stretching sessions are offered. The night before the competition, camping with a campfire and outdoor movie is organized. There is a painting workshop for children during the race. The routes include technical descents and pass through picturesque areas, making them ideal for mountain trail running enthusiasts.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: The Suceava City Run is a popular running race held in the city of Suceava, offering participants an outdoor sporting experience with routes suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The event includes races for children, a popular race, and a cross race, promoting movement and community spirit. Participants can run on routes passing through historic and picturesque areas, surrounded by castles and local landscapes. Organizers provide a participation kit and prizes for competitors, encouraging involvement and athletic performance.
course_highlights: Routes through historic areas and castles in Suceava
Races dedicated to children, a popular race, and a cross race
Event for all ages and fitness levels
additional: The participation kit is guaranteed only for those registered and confirmed by June 30, 2025. The event includes races for children, a popular race, and a cross race, with prizes and participation kits. There is an active TRIB community that organizes other runs and charity events. The event features community activities and various race categories, with registration details and regulations available on the official website.

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills is a mountain running race organized in Crasna, Sălaj County, taking place on May 16, 2026. The event invites running enthusiasts to explore the picturesque hills of the area, offering a sporting experience in nature. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy beautiful landscapes and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain trail in Crasna, Sălaj County
Picturesque natural scenery
Outdoor event on May 16
additional: The event has already had previous editions, with positive results and feedback, being a local tradition to promote sport and health.

name: SEMIMARATON FETESTI
description: The Fetești Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings together runners from the region for races of various distances, including a half marathon and cross-country runs. The organizers, the Fetești Running Sports Association, promote sport and health within the community, offering a pleasant and competitive experience. The event has a local tradition and takes place on varied routes suitable for all levels of runners.
course_highlights: Half marathon route of 21 km
Cross-country races of 10 km and 5 km
Special category for school champions (ages 6-13)
additional: Half marathon, registration information available on the website and Facebook, local route

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
location: Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition testing strength, speed, agility, and skills, held at the Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition, scheduled for May 17, 2026, challenges participants to push their limits through an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to cater to both experienced runners and those seeking a shorter challenge.
course_highlights: Obstacle course testing strength, speed, and agility
Location at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park, Cluj-Napoca
Available distances: 6 km and 12 km
additional: The event includes technical and strength obstacles, with details about registration and participation available on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Crosul Sport4All
location: Universitatea Europeană Drăgan, Lugoj, Timiș County, Romania
description: Crosul Sport 4 all is an annual running sports event organized in Lugoj, aimed at all ages and levels of fitness. The event includes non-timed races for children and a popular 2 km race, as well as timed races of 4 km and 6 km for older participants. The routes are loops around the European Drăgan University and through the city’s main streets, offering a pleasant urban experience. Participants receive participation medals, and the timed races are organized with age categories. The event is supported by the Lugoj City Hall and the European Drăgan University, with 400 free spots offered by the sponsor Mondial S.A.
course_highlights: Loop routes around the European Drăgan University and through Lugoj's main streets
Races for all ages, including non-timed races for children and timed races of 4 km and 6 km
Participation medals for all participants in non-timed races
additional: Registration is open online until 10.05.2026 at 23:59 or until the 400 free spots are filled. Participation kits are distributed on Saturday and Sunday at the European Drăgan University. The event includes an award ceremony for the timed races and sessions for warm-up and technical briefing before the start. Volunteers receive a volunteer kit and a volunteer contract in accordance with the law. The event features races for children and adults, non-timed and timed races, urban routes, online registration, participation kits, medals and diplomas for participants, and is organized in partnership with Lugoj City Hall and the European Drăgan University.

name: MARATONUL NISIPULUI Run&Fun
location: Plaja Zoom Beach, Constanța, Constanța County, Romania
description: The Sand Marathon Run & Fun, which will take place on May 17, 2026, at Zoom Beach Beach in Constanța, is a sporting event that combines competition with fun and the promotion of a healthy lifestyle. The event offers six varied races, from the 42 km marathon to recreational runs for the whole family, held on the sands of the Romanian coast. Participants can enjoy spectacular routes with sea breezes, in an atmosphere full of energy and community. The marathon is a celebration of movement, nature, and adventure, aimed at both professional and amateur runners.
course_highlights: Routes on the sands of the Romanian coast with sea breeze
Hydration points at the start/finish and at km 2.5 on Reyna beach
Moderately high difficulty route, with multiple loops and clear markings
additional: Start will be given from the vibrant heart of Constanța on May 17, 2026. The marathon route consists of 7 km loops on sand, with a time limit of 6 hours. Race modifications are possible free of charge until 01.05.2026, afterwards with an additional fee. Participation kits are not shipped by courier in case of non-participation. Multiple race categories, routes on the sands of the coast, activities for families and the community, an event promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is the largest cross-country cycling marathon in Romania, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, with a distance of approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no significant elevation changes. The event gathers cycling enthusiasts from all over the country, providing an energetic and friendly atmosphere, ideal for opening the MTB marathon season.
course_highlights: Approximately 55 km route through forests and country roads
No significant elevation changes, suitable for an accessible experience
Classic Bucharest - Snagov route
additional: Packet pickup is available on Friday and Saturday before the race at Greenfield Plaza Băneasa. Participants can expect a varied route with natural terrains and diverse landscapes, making it a landmark event for mountain biking in Romania.

name: SEMIMARATONUL SIRETULUI In memoriam Ilie Roșu
JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba, Romania

description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle, in the heart of Transylvania. The race combines running and cycling on scenic routes that pass through the Jidvei vineyard, offering participants spectacular landscapes and an authentic experience in nature. The event includes races for all levels of fitness, from children to adults, and offers recreational and oenogastronomic activities for the whole family. It is a celebration of sport, culture, and local tradition, with a friendly and safe atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through vineyards and ancient forests
Spectacular landscapes in the Jidvei vineyard, in the heart of Transylvania
Event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle
additional: Participation kits are available for races of 42km, 21km, 10km, and 5km, as well as for children's races of 1km and 2km. Prizes for the youngest runners. Relaxation activities and oenogastronomic experiences are included in the event. Organizers prepare a world full of fun and creative workshops for children, in a safe and friendly setting. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races, and the event also features a grape harvest competition, guided tours, activities for children, charitable donations, and wine and traditional food tastings.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The routes are challenging, with significant elevation differences and diverse obstacles designed to test both the physical endurance and willpower of participants. The event offers an initiation and reconnection experience with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with specific difficulties and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and struggle, and after the race, participants are invited to discover local culture and enjoy traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1060 m elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and kit pickup will be on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00, at the Dacian Village Domain. The routes include various obstacles such as fences, jumps over logs, rings, sandbags, log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, mud canal, wall crossing, and a surprise obstacle. There are prize categories by age and gender, with cash prizes for top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a difficult OCR. The event includes different distance categories and routes, open to both amateur and advanced runners.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, which will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating Heroes' Day and promoting mass sports activities. The event brings together the local community and amateur athletes, offering a half marathon race and other sporting events. The route starts from the Central Square and passes through the main streets of the city, organized under the patronage of Prince Radu and with the support of several local institutions and associations. Participants are encouraged to read the regulations, register, and donate to support the cause.
course_highlights: Urban route with start and finish in the Central Square of Bistrița
Passes through the main streets of the city: Dornei Street, Șincai Street, Mihai Eminescu Street, Republic Boulevard, Barbu Șt. Delavrancea Street
Event dedicated to commemorating Heroes' Day and promoting mass sports
additional: Online registrations are validated until May 1, 2026; the event is organized by the Invictus Volunteers Association - Bistrița Branch, under the High Patronage of Prince Radu; participants can obtain the official Invictus T-shirt and related merchandise; the event also includes other sporting events besides the half marathon; reading the regulations is recommended for details about equipment, timing, and prizes. Four different routes, simplified registration, donation required for the T-shirt, event for all ages, solidarity activities, and expressions of gratitude.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night running race in the heart of Bukovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere under the stars. The event is organized to promote outdoor activity and a healthy lifestyle, involving the local community and supporting the education of underprivileged children. Participants can choose from several distances, from half marathon to children's races, enjoying an authentic nature experience with hydration points, hot meals, and prizes. The festival combines sport with a friendly and environmentally responsible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Spectacular night routes through the forests and ridges of Bukovina
Hydration and feeding points along the course
Festival atmosphere with general access and hot meal at the finish
additional: Participants receive a personalized bib with timing chip, access to hydration and feeding points, a general access bracelet to the festival area, a hot meal at the finish, and cash prizes in age categories and OPEN. The festival offers accommodation options in camping sites or partner hotels and recommends traveling by train or bus to reduce environmental impact. Multiple race distances, festival atmosphere, prizes, real-time results, participant facilities, charitable purpose.

description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the Mujdeni Lake area, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers diverse routes for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, catering to both professional athletes and amateurs passionate about nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked trails and significant elevation changes, set in a picturesque natural environment. Organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the competitive and friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: MTB Marathon Route: 44 km with an elevation gain of 1180 m
MTB Race Route: 34 km with an elevation gain of 930 m
Trail Running Half Marathon: 25 km with an elevation gain of 990 m
additional: The routes have significant elevation differences, from 184 m for Fun Run (6 km) to 1180 m for MTB Marathon (44 km). Registration of minors requires written consent from parents or guardians. The organizer is Societatea Carpatină Ardeleană - Satu Mare. Phone contact: +40-743-419443. Participation is exclusively online, and the event includes various routes from 6 km to marathon, adapted for different levels of preparation.

name: S24H
location: Parcul Copiilor „Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: S24H is an international ultra-marathon race held in the 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park in Timișoara, Romania. Participants run on a paved track of 1222.75 meters, illuminated at night, aiming to cover the greatest distance in 6, 12, or 24 hours. The event is open to both professionals and amateur endurance runners, offering a transformative experience and a significant mental and physical challenge. Additionally, there are races of 50 and 100 km, as well as a 12-hour relay for teams of four.
course_highlights: Paved track of 1222.75 meters in 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park
The track is illuminated at night for runners' safety
Two hydration and refreshment points along the course, with water, glucose, electrolytes, fruits, and snacks
additional: There are pavilions/tents along the course where runners can store their personal equipment, food, and sleeping bags. The participation kit can be picked up the day before, and a medical certificate is mandatory for all individual events, except for relays. The event includes a briefing for runners and a pasta party before the race. The event takes place on a paved and illuminated route, with the possibility to participate in multiple distance and time categories, making it an excellent opportunity to test physical and mental endurance.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultra-marathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, with numerous ascents and descents, all starting and ending at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognized as an UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity, and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior experience in mountain running for the longer races, and all finishers within the time limits receive a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Trails through narrow paths and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridges
Start and finish at Bran Castle area
additional: Technical SportHG shirts available until May 1, 2026, later replaced with neckwarmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between control points. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail running experience, and registrations are made online, with limited spots.

name: SEMIMARATONUL EROILOR INVICTUS
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual race organized in Timisoara, dedicated to heroes and supporting injured soldiers. The event promotes the spirit of victory and national values through sport, being part of the Invictus Romania project. The 4th edition continues the tradition of bringing together runners and supporters in an atmosphere of respect and solidarity. Participants can also contribute through donations to support injured soldiers.
course_highlights: Symbolic routes in the colors of the national flag: blue, yellow, and red
Event of solidarity and national commemoration
Organized by Invictus Romania, with a tradition of over a decade

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and the peaks of the Nemira massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suitable for experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes through shaded forests and alpine areas with wild natural scenery
Tourist marking in 90% of the course and additional signage in difficult areas
Significant elevation changes with spectacular ascents and descents
additional: The routes include marathon, half-marathon, and cross races, with positive elevation gains between 700 m and 2400 m. The start is from the Central Park of Slănic Moldova resort. The courses are 80-90% runnable, featuring forest roads, alpine trails, and rugged zones. Organizers recommend mountain experience and appropriate equipment. There is also a race for children to encourage outdoor running. The event includes routes for children, emphasizing ecotourism and community involvement, providing information about registrations, accommodation, and routes.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the spa resort of Călimănești-Căciulata. The event, organized by the Pegas Triathlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and fundraising for humanitarian causes. Participants cover three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require experience and mountain skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race, all runners are invited to a lunch at the Turnu Monastery.
course_highlights: Unmarked mountain routes with significant elevation changes (e.g., 30 km with 2000 m elevation gain)
Passing through localities, alpine meadows, wooded areas, and mountain peaks
Routes including segments with fixed ropes and rugged terrain, requiring mountain experience
additional: Number distribution takes place in two stages: Friday evening and Saturday morning. The start for the Cozia (30 km) and Stănișoara (21 km) routes is at 08:00, and for the Turnu (4 km) route at 09:00. There is an 8-hour time limit for the Cozia and Stănișoara routes. The children's race is held at the Turnu Monastery Camping with a start at 16:00, and registration for children is free. After the race, all participants are invited to a lunch after the Holy Liturgy at the Turnu Monastery. Mountain routes, 8-hour time limit, for participants over 18 years old, emphasizing running and hiking, promoting the natural and cultural beauty of the area.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in the spectacular landscapes of the Carpathian Mountains, in the Stâna de Vale resort, Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner-friendly routes to challenging mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked trails, full support along the way, and a friendly atmosphere after the race. The race weekend includes an 8 km vertical race, an 11 km classic race, and a 33 km long race with significant elevation changes.
course_highlights: Mountain trail of 33 km with 1500 m positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
11 km trail suitable for beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
8 km vertical race with 1100 m elevation gain, with continuous and demanding ascent
additional: The event takes place on July 10-11, 2026, with race packets pickup at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The 8K Vertical Race starts on Friday at 10:00 AM, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30 respectively. Organizers provide a meal after the race and a celebration after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35-79 age category. The routes are in mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to match their level of preparation.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including an ultra race of 103 km with a elevation gain of over 5000 meters. ZUT is more than a competition; it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting the spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, providing an authentic trail running experience in impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: ULTRA route of 103 km with 5255 m elevation gain
Well-equipped refreshment and control points along the route
Variety of races: from 2.5 km for children to the 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races adapted to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and refreshment points offer water, isotonic drinks, fruits, and hot food along the ultra route. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also has an ecological awareness component.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail running routes suitable for all levels of fitness, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, providing a complete mountain running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of Piatra Mare mountain.
course_highlights: 100% trail run routes through forests and mountain trails
Challenging ascents, including over 500 m elevation gain over 4 km at K24
Spectacular views from Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Piatra Mare Peak, and Garbova Cabin
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cross, K24 Half Marathon, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Marathon, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is from the base of the Clăbucet slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape with the Predeal Forest Run red logo and are supported by volunteers. Time limits and refreshment points are set for the competitive races. The participation kit will be announced later. Participants can register for various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Details about registration and rules are available on the official website.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Bate Toaca Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, part of the Carpathians Circuit. The event offers two main routes: the Dochia Race of 18 km with an elevation gain of approximately 1500 m and the Bate Toaca Race of 31 km with an elevation gain of approximately 2700 m. The routes pass through spectacular landscapes, including Dochia Cabin, Lespezi Peak, and Toaca Peak, providing an authentic and challenging mountain experience for runners. Organizers ensure a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with significant elevation differences (1500 m and 2700 m)
Spectacular landscapes in the Durău area, including Toaca Peak and Dochia Cabin
Marked routes with various symbols (red ribbon, yellow triangle, red cross, red dot)
additional: The routes are well marked with different symbols and include ascents and descents on stairs at Toaca Peak. Bate Toaca Race is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The organizer is the SPORT.NATURA Piatra Neamț Association. Phone contact is available for logistics and secretariat. The event also includes results and rules from previous editions, as well as information about registrations and participation.

description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race held over 250 km divided into 6 stages, in self-sufficient mode, exploring the pure wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu, Buzău area. Participants will traverse a challenging route in the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary landscapes and places filled with stories and local mysteries. After completing the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania's traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions such as Peles Castle and Bran Castle. The event emphasizes life experience, long-term friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.
course_highlights: 250 km route divided into 6 stages in the Carpathian Mountains
Legendary sites such as Vulturilor Lake and Cascada Cașoca
Wild landscapes and local mysteries in the Buzău area
additional: The race is self-sufficient, with camping in tents during the 6 stages. Medical assistance, water at control points and camps, hot meals, bus transportation before and after the race, medals, and finisher T-shirts are provided. After the race, a 2-day cultural tour is organized in Brașov, Bran, and Sinaia, with hotel accommodation and meals included. Satellite SPOT live tracking is available for competitors. Participants must be prepared for wilderness conditions, with mandatory equipment and strict safety rules; the event also includes a cultural excursion after the race.

name: Retezat Mountain Run

Participants enjoy an authentic mountain running experience, with cash and object prizes, as well as a friendly and festive atmosphere.

additional: Registration and kit distribution take place on Friday between 15:00-23:00 and Saturday between 6:00-9:00 at Apres Ski, the base of the slope. description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual Cross Country running competition held in the Breazu area, Rediu commune, Iași County, with start and finish in front of the forest ranger station in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied routes include wooded areas, meadows, forest and agricultural roads, offering a unique outdoor running experience with flat sections, descents, and ramps. The event promotes outdoor sports and supports local social causes, providing an opportunity for joy and gathering for running enthusiasts. The half marathon distance and other races are suitable for different training levels, and the organization includes hydration points and referees on the course.
course_highlights: Routes combining forest roads, meadows, and agricultural roads
Varied terrain with flat sections, descents, and ramps
Hydration points at km 3, 5, and 8.5, used also for the half marathon
additional: The routes are supervised by referees and photographers, and traffic is not closed. The event supports local social causes through voluntary donations. Warming up before running is recommended. There are control points 200 meters from start/finish for all races. Trails include forest and meadow paths, Cross Country race, social involvement, promotion of nature and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event organized in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, by the Alternative Sports Club Timișoara. The competition includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) races held on mountain trails that cross the Cerna Mountains and connect the 39 hamlets in the area. It is one of the first mountain marathons in the region, offering an authentic trail running experience in spectacular natural landscapes. The event is dedicated to runners passionate about mountain terrain and adventure.
course_highlights: Mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains
Connects 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Distances of Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km)
additional: The routes pass through scenic areas and may include varied mountain terrain; registration details are not specified

name: Bucharest Marathon
description: Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon is an iconic sporting event held annually in Bucharest, offering races for all levels of runners. The courses include the full marathon of 42 km, the half marathon of 21 km, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting from Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban route passing through important points of the capital, with hydration and support stations along the way.
course_highlights: Urban route through emblematic points of Bucharest
Variety of races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, popular race, and 4x relay
Start and finish in Constitution Square
additional: Participation kits can be picked up before the race at the designated location. The event includes hydration and medical support stations along the route. There are pacemakers for the main races. After the race, participants receive prizes and medals. Organizers support charitable causes through partner NGOs. The event features charitable partnerships, exhibitions, and prizes for winners, with registration and kit pickup details available on the official website.

description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience on four spectacular routes with views of Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, as well as an atmosphere full of adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people with the same passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare
Routes in the Baiului Mountains with support points offering water, energy drinks, and fruits
Different start times for the main races and children's races, including special routes with cable car transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual timing with chip, support points with water and fruits, finisher medals, cash prizes and sports equipment, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, official photo and video album. Cable car transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. The awards ceremony is at 17:00, with a SuperParty on Saturday evening featuring DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation differences, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

The event includes two main distances: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, being in its 15th edition, and promises a pleasant and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country trail in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic landscapes
Marked routes supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. There are official partners and supporters of the race. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, providing an opportunity to discover the natural beauty of the area and participate in a community sports activity.

description: The 'Saturday Running' Half Marathon in Călărași is an iconic sporting event for the local community, bringing together amateur and professional runners in a friendly and motivating competition. The course takes place in Central Park, offering a pleasant and accessible experience for all participants. The atmosphere is one of support and camaraderie, with dedicated facilities for runners' comfort, including tents for relaxation and first aid. The event promotes personal progress and the sporting spirit, providing an excellent opportunity for socialization and testing endurance.
course_highlights: Course in Central Park (Parcul Mare) in Călărași
Metal tents for refuge and first aid provided by Expodom
Friendly atmosphere and mutual support among participants
additional: Participants can run a 5 km race in Central Park near Queen restaurant. Registration confirmation is done via email after completing online payment through MobilPay (Netopia). Organizers offer a gift voucher for registration and provide tents for relaxation and first aid. The refund and return policy is available on the website. The event includes a half marathon and a 5 km race, with registrations and results available online, as well as gift options for participants.

name: Timișoara City Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running competition held in Timisoara, offering races on various distances from 1 km up to the full marathon of 42 km. The event promotes freedom and community spirit, inviting runners of all levels to participate and push their limits. With a solid tradition and dedicated training programs, the marathon is an inspiring and energizing experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1 km, 4 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km
Event organized in Timisoara, with urban routes
Strong community and personalized training programs
additional: There are training programs for all main distances (5 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, 42 km) created by an experienced university coach. The event includes free short-distance races for children. Relay races for the marathon and half marathon are also available. Participants can benefit from marathon training programs, including plans for beginners and intermediates, as well as tips for equipment and physical preparation.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, transforming each kilometer into a symbol of an active and healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic and united sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: Urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
Community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event dedicated to both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts from Otelec and ends in Victory Square, offering a unique experience through the story of Eugeniu de Savoya's arrival. The half marathon and cross-country races feature varied routes passing through the city's markets, parks, and historic neighborhoods, highlighting the local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, Pasta Party, and a special anniversary race "106 pentru POLI".
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, from Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines markets and parks in the Fabric district along the Bega River
Cross-country races pass through parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric neighborhood
additional: Kit distribution takes place at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. The marathon begins with a bus departure at 06:30 from Victory Square to Otelec. Energizing products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, Pasta Party, and the anniversary race "106 pentru POLI" on October 29, 2026, at Știința Stadium. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races suitable for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children's race, a 10 km race, and a half marathon of 21.1 km, held on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, a friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It is an excellent opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized and friendly setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km and half marathon races
Children's race on completely safe, paved routes closed to traffic
Hydration points and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children's race is free, intended for children between 4 and 13 years old, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on completely safe routes closed to traffic. Participation of children requires the mandatory presence of a parent or guardian throughout the race. Medals, diplomas, and product prizes are offered to all participants, and routes for adults include hydration points and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity within the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied routes for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country, 6 km race, children's race, family run, and a race dedicated to people with special abilities "And I CAN!". The routes pass through forests, hills, and historical sites such as Hațeg Royal Fortress, providing a technical and spectacular experience. The organization is appreciated for clear markings and a friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Routes through forests and hills with technical ascents and descents
Passing through Hațeg Royal Fortress, an emblematic historical site
Varied landscapes including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and Covragiu village
additional: Kit pickup is between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The start for the 6 km cross-country, 12 km cross-country, and half marathon is at 10:00 AM, while the Family run and "And I CAN!" race begin at 15:00. Registrations for children's races and the Family run can also be made on-site, subject to availability. It is recommended to choose a T-shirt size smaller than usual due to manufacturing tolerance. The event includes cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Tara Hategului area.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail race in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest, which started in 2018 and has grown to over 2,400 participants. The event offers four categories: half marathon, 11 km cross, fast 6 km run, and a non-competitive Family Run of 3 km, suitable for all running levels. The race emphasizes the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, organized by a passionate running team. Participants benefit from group training sessions with different paces, coordinated by coaches, to prepare optimally for race day.
course_highlights: 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
Various categories: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and Family Run 3 km
Organized group training sessions with different paces
additional: Organized group training sessions with different paces and coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive event for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with the Magic Association and the Day of Good Association. It includes multiple race categories, details about the route and instructions for participants, as well as support for social causes.

The routes offer a unique experience, crossing natural and historical landscapes, with traces of the Dacians, Romans, and prehistoric life. The event is dedicated to both amateurs and professionals, promoting outdoor activity and passion for mountain running. Participants can enjoy three different races, each with its own challenges and beauties.
course_highlights: Trails on the hills and paths in the Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru area
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and Buzău city
Marked routes through forests, forest roads, and historical zones with Dacian and Roman traces

Routes of 3 km, 7.5 km, 12.5 km, and 20 km; mountain running event in nature; participation scheduled for November 7, 2026.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover the capital of Romania in a unique way, through running. The route is flat, smooth, and ideal for setting personal records, crossing green parks and combining old architecture with the modern energy of the city. The event is suitable for both elite runners and passionate amateurs, offering a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It is a perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city still undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat and smooth route, ideal for personal records
Green parks integrated into the route
Unique combination of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The route includes hydration points every 5 km, and a lively atmosphere characteristic of Romania's capital.

The event includes several running categories with distances of 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family event, suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural route, away from asphalt, in a picturesque and healthy setting.
course_highlights: Trail on cool paths in Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family event
Event organized in nature, away from asphalt
additional: The event includes registration packages with a T-shirt and race number. There are categories for all ages, including a dedicated family race. The route is on natural forest trails, providing a trail running experience in nature. The start takes place in the evening, offering a special night run atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing, and medical assistance, with online registration only and a registration deadline until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event organized in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Uprising of November 15, 1987, by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main race is a 5-kilometer road run held along the historic route of the uprising, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races dedicated to children, with distances adapted to their age, to promote movement and team spirit. The event is organized by the Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: Historical 5 km route through the streets of the 1987 Brașov Uprising
Urban course on roads through Brașov, including historical and cultural points
Races for children with distances between 250m and 1.2km, adapted to age groups

The race starts inside the Roman industrial park, exactly from the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, the place where the uprising erupted. Running through the streets of Brașov, 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the race offers various routes, including the 50 km ultramarathon, team races, half marathon, cross country, and children's races. Participants can support one of Romania's nine historical regions, enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and feeding points. The event also includes live streaming, modern facilities, and prizes for winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and feeding points with water, isotonic drinks, fruits, and sweets
The last 12 km are mostly downhill, with a single ascent of over 100 meters
additional: The runner's kit includes a race number with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and real-time rankings, finisher medal, access to hydration and feeding points with sweet and salty products, still and mineral water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruits. There is a refund guarantee if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9 hours for Ultra 50k, 5 hours for Half 25k, 3 hours for Cross 15k, and 1 hour 30 minutes for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Multiple race distances including Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children's races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and award ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The December 1st Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, dedicated to runners of all levels. The event offers a pleasant sporting experience, with well-organized routes and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can benefit from participation kits and careful organizational support, ensuring a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, involving the community in a noble purpose.
course_highlights: Route held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Participation kits handed out in person or through a representative with documents
Kit pickup schedule over three days before the race
additional: Kit pickup takes place over three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (B-dul Unirii, no. 69) and ParkLake Shopping Center. The kit is only handed to the registered and validated person, based on an identity document, and can be collected by another person only with a signed copy of the ID. For the youth race, the kit is only handed to minors accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

In its 9th edition, the main race Ultra 50k is favored by trail runners for its challenge and the beauty of the route, which includes forests, ascents, and spectacular descents. Participants can support one of Romania's 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-equipped refreshment points and personalized medals for finishers. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: 50 km route with ascents and descents through the forests around Cluj
Control and hydration points with varied food (water, isotonic drinks, fruits, sweets, salty foods)
Scenic views over Cluj Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, Muzeul Poarta de’ Feleac, and Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The runner's kit includes a race number with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and real-time rankings, a personalized finisher medal, access to hydration and refreshment points with sweet, salty, isotonic drinks, and fruits. There are races for children and team races with special distancing rules between members. Time limits: 9 hours for Ultra 50k, 5 hours for Half 25k, 3 hours for Cross 15k, 1 hour 30 minutes for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various Romanian historical regions and enjoy diverse routes, from trail to cross, with open registrations and early bird prices.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who wish to support a noble cause through sport. The event offers a pleasant running experience in a friendly environment, promoting the local running community and social involvement. This is the first edition of this race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km route in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarie' Palliative Care Center for severely ill children
Options of 2 km race (family, non-competitive) and 6 km race (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on December 11-12, 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with a positive elevation gain of 9,250 meters, considered difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 meters of elevation difference, of intermediate difficulty. The race is recognized for its demanding mountain terrain and the Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking top endurance competition. Participants can track their performances through a personalized results board.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with positive elevation gains of 4,600 m and 9,250 m respectively
Mountain terrain with intermediate and difficult difficulty levels
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event features a personalized results board for participants to track their performance. There are no details about registration fees or start times. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The 'Down Argeș Half Marathon' is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The routes start from Strand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Strand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a unique natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children's races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is lively, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strand Park, near the Summer Theater
Route through Lunca Argeșului and Strand parks
Running along the Argeș River promenade, with scenic views
additional: Kit pickup is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theater for those outside Pitești. The start of the half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races is at 10:00 AM in Strand Park. The children's race begins at 12:30 PM, and the awards ceremony is at 1:00 PM. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian at registration and kit pickup. The event includes online registration, kit pickup on 12.12.2026, and results and photo verification after the event.

name: RUBICON - CURSA EROILOR Ultramaraton: Bucuresti - Chisinau
TTR BACKYARD ULTRA ~ 2026
location: Satul Roșu, Chiajna, Ilfov County, Romania
description: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA 2026 is an official endurance running competition organized by the TIME TRIAL RUNNING community, supported by the Chiajna City Hall and local parishes. The event takes place in the village of Roșu, Chiajna commune, on April 17, 2026, starting at 14:00, at the Sports Hall of the "Doamna Chiajna" Technological High School. It is a unique Backyard Ultra race, with a single event covering a distance of 6.706 km, alternating between two different routes, one during the day and one at night. The challenge is to complete the route in less than 60 minutes and to be present at each hourly start, with the last remaining competitor declared the winner.
course_highlights: Unique distance of 6.706 km with two different routes alternated
Day route along the dyke/west side of Lake Morii
Night route through the streets of Roșu village and Chiajna promenade
additional: The start is given exactly on the hour, every hour, and participants must complete the route in less than 60 minutes to continue. The base camp includes indoor spaces (Sports Hall with changing rooms and toilets) and outdoor spaces (synthetic grass park). A refreshment and hydration point is available at the start/finish area, and hot meals will be offered according to the schedule. The winner (Last One Standing), second place (Assist), and the best-placed girl (Last Woman Standing) will be awarded. Each participant receives a personalized trophy at the end. name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition organized in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Natural Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross with 680 m elevation gain and a 23 km semi-marathon with 1300 m elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes with dramatic landscapes and mountain trails. Participants can experience running under limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and ascending to impressive panoramic points. It is a race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular landscapes with limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb towards the Săndulești Cross with 360° views over the Apuseni Mountains
additional: Start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Salvamont Base. name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, on tourist trails in the Zărand Mountains, between the localities of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the natural and historical heritage of the area, connecting the castles of Șoimoș and Șiria by running, as well as other points of interest. The routes offer an adventure experience with spring landscapes and a medieval atmosphere, suitable for both amateurs and professionals. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendar.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with tourist trails, forest roads, and paved roads
